title: Schema Registry
description: Registry of all data schemas in the system. Each schema file validates one type of data exchange.

raw_macro.description: Input — Macroeconomic indicators (US/CN/JP/Commodity) with data source annotations

raw_market.description: Input — ETF market data: prices, technicals, valuation, flows, momentum

scores_L1.description: Output — L1 macro environment scores: US(5 factors) + CN(5 factors) → weighted composite

scores_L2.description: Output — L2 style factor scores: momentum/value/growth/profitability/size with per-ETF FF5 loadings

scores_L3.description: Output — L3 market sentiment + quantitative risk scores (VaR/CVaR/drawdown)

scores_composite.description: Output — Consolidated L1×w1+L2×w2+L3×w3 → position band + per-asset allocation

alert.description: Output — Trigger/alert event with level, throttling metadata, and actionable recommendations

system_state.description: Internal — System state snapshot for context recovery. Read on LLM context reset.

analysis_summary.description: Output — Compressed analysis summary (scores + conclusions + falsification, no narrative prose). Downstream agents read this instead of full markdown reports.
